Chinese internet emo selfies from around 2009: a steep high-angle shot with the phone or compact camera held overhead, smoothed pale skin, a pink-violet cast, glitter, star and heart stickers, and one slanted line of white handwritten Chinese. Streaked fringes, plaid shirts, skull tees, internet cafés, karaoke rooms and dorms suit it best.

Adding normal eyes with clear dark pupils keeps them from blowing out to white. LoRA 1.0.
